payload.anomaly: chef (unified-agent) recurring FALSE send_telegram parser-failure → self-blocks publication
payload.symptom: Chef completed full TNB 6-layer analysis (4 clusters) but reported send_telegram 'expected record received string' parser error on long/Vietnamese payloads, logged notebook 'PUBLICATION BLOCKED', and did NOT publish the intraday MARKET dish. Claimed the gateway rejects messages >150 chars / non-ASCII.
payload.diagnosis: FALSE failure. 'expected record received string' is an ARGUMENT-SHAPE error — chef passed send_telegram `message` as a bare string instead of a `{channel, message}` record. send_telegram demonstrably handles Vietnamese multi-paragraph text: notebook precedent msg_id 711 (2026-06-10 08:52 eod) + 714 (19:37 evening), and the prior-day dispatcher-completed publish MARKET id=710 (2026-06-10 intraday). Dispatcher called send_telegram with the correct {channel,message} record and BOTH MARKET + WORK sends returned success on the first try.
payload.dispatcher_action: RAW-verified (read_telegram_reports market channel newest = id 3128 / 2026-06-11T00:08, no dish landed → chef's claim of a partial 'first short message succeeded' also false). Completed the publish itself: MARKET 4-para plain-VI dish + WORK [CHEF-DETAIL] TNB audit (faithful to chef's logged 6-layer synthesis, numbers re-grounded on live get_market_snapshot + get_macro_snapshot at 02:30 UTC). Corrected chef notebook publication_status BLOCKED→PUBLISHED. BUG channel logged (message_id 2779).
payload.verification_note: Dish-channel content-read is NOT available — read_telegram_reports(channel=market|market-group) returns the internal market_messages signals table (ids 31xx, analysis-agent), not the outbound MARKET Telegram dish channel (7xx id-space). RAW verification therefore = direct send_telegram success return (called by dispatcher, not a sub-agent badge) + correct record-shape args + works-precedent. send_telegram to BUG returned a DB message_id (2779); MARKET/WORK returned outbound-success strings without DB ids (separate outbound store).
payload.impact: Intraday dish would have been silently dropped on every chef cycle that hits this mis-call. This is the 3rd publish-reliability failure of the same agent — recurring per feedback_recurring_bug_escalation (2+ same module → architect review).
payload.recommended_action: po/architect: fix chef.md Step 7 send_telegram call to ALWAYS pass arguments as a {channel, message} record (never a bare string), and add a positive self-check (re-read own post via a working read path OR trust the success return) so chef stops self-diagnosing a non-existent 'parser failure'. Remove the false 'parser breaks on >150 chars / non-ASCII' lore from the flow. Consider a publish-guard: if chef logs BLOCKED-by-tool, dispatcher auto-completes (already the standing posture) but the root mis-call must be fixed in the agent.
